knowledge:
- key_parameters: species=Character vector of species names to map transcripts to genes ;; kallisto_out_path=Path to the directory containing kallisto bus output files ;; ensembl_version=Ensembl release version to ensure compatibility with the transcriptome index ;; write_tr2g=Logical indicating whether to write the tr2g mapping to a file ;; est_ncells=Estimated number of cells for sparse matrix construction ;; est_ngenes=Estimated number of genes for sparse matrix construction ;; gene_biotype_use=Biotypes to filter (e.g., "cellranger" to match Cell Ranger's reference) ;; out_path=Directory to save output files ;; Genome=BSgenome or DNAStringSet object representing the genome for GTF/GFF3 extraction ;; get_transcriptome=Logical indicating whether to extract the transcriptome from TxDb/EnsDb
- alternatives: The command-line tool bustools is a more efficient implementation of make_sparse_matrix and transcript-to-gene sorting. The kb-python wrapper (kb) is recommended over manual kallisto bus + BUSpaRse for standard workflows as it downloads prebuilt indices and runs bustools directly.
- when_to_use: Use when processing raw scRNA-seq data from pseudoalignments (specifically BUS format from kallisto bus) to generate sparse gene count or TCC matrices, and when custom transcript-to-gene mappings or custom transcriptome filtering (by biotype/chromosome) are required.
- pitfalls: The make_sparse_matrix function is deprecated/historical because bustools is much more efficient. Ensure the Ensembl version used for tr2g mapping matches the Ensembl version of the transcriptome used for the kallisto index. Versioning of Ensembl for plants, fungi, etc. (ensemblgenomes.org) is different from the vertebrate site. TxDb objects (like TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene) do not contain biotype information or gene symbols.

workflows.name: bus_to_sparse_matrix_and_filtering
workflows.intent: Convert sorted BUS output files into sparse gene count and TCC matrices, and filter out empty droplets using knee plots.
input: ./out_hgmm100/matrix.ec (equivalence class file, implicitly read by make_sparse_matrix in the same directory)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate transcript-to-gene mapping using transcript2gene ;; 2. Convert sorted BUS file to sparse gene count and TCC matrices using make_sparse_matrix ;; 3. Calculate total counts per barcode using Matrix::colSums ;; 4. Get knee plot data frame using get_knee_df ;; 5. Identify the inflection point using get_inflection ;; 6. Plot the knee plot using knee_plot ;; 7. Filter the sparse matrix to remove empty droplets
workflows.code:
tr2g <- transcript2gene(species = c("Homo sapiens", "Mus musculus"), 
                        kallisto_out_path = "./out_hgmm100", ensembl_version = 99,
                        write_tr2g = FALSE)
head(tr2g)
c(gene_count, tcc) %<-% make_sparse_matrix("./out_hgmm100/output.sorted.txt",
                               tr2g = tr2g, est_ncells = 1e5,
                               est_ngenes = nrow(tr2g))
dim(gene_count)
tot_counts <- Matrix::colSums(gene_count)
summary(tot_counts)
df1 <- get_knee_df(gene_count)
infl1 <- get_inflection(df1)
knee_plot(df1, infl1)
gene_count <- gene_count[, tot_counts > infl1]
dim(gene_count)
dim(tcc)
tot_counts <- Matrix::colSums(tcc)
summary(tot_counts)
df2 <- get_knee_df(tcc)
infl2 <- get_inflection(df2)
knee_plot(df2, infl2)
tcc <- tcc[, tot_counts > infl2]
dim(tcc)

workflows.name: transcript_to_gene_generation
workflows.intent: Generate transcript-to-gene (tr2g) mapping files and filtered transcriptomes from various annotation sources (Ensembl, FASTA, GTF, TxDb, EnsDb).
workflows.stages: 1. Download and filter transcriptome using dl_transcriptome ;; 2. Generate tr2g mapping from Ensembl using tr2g_ensembl ;; 3. Extract tr2g mapping from a FASTA file using tr2g_fasta ;; 4. Extract tr2g mapping and transcriptome from a GTF file and genome using tr2g_gtf ;; 5. Extract tr2g mapping from a TxDb object using tr2g_TxDb ;; 6. Extract tr2g mapping from an EnsDb object using tr2g_EnsDb
workflows.code:
dl_transcriptome("Drosophila melanogaster", out_path = "fly", 
                 gene_biotype_use = "cellranger", verbose = FALSE)
list.files("fly")
dl_transcriptome("Caenorhabditis elegans", out_path = "worm", verbose = FALSE,
                 gene_biotype_use = "cellranger", ensembl_version = 115)
list.files("worm")
dl_transcriptome("Saccharomyces cerevisiae", out_path = "yeast", 
                 type = "fungus", gene_biotype_use = "cellranger", 
                 verbose = FALSE)
list.files("yeast")
tr2g_mm <- tr2g_ensembl("Mus musculus", ensembl_version = 115, 
                        other_attrs = "description", 
                        gene_biotype_use = "cellranger")
head(tr2g_mm)
tr2g_at <- tr2g_ensembl("Arabidopsis thaliana", type = "plant")
head(tr2g_at)
toy_fasta <- system.file("testdata/fasta_test.fasta", package = "BUSpaRse")
tr2g_fa <- tr2g_fasta(file = toy_fasta, write_tr2g = FALSE, save_filtered = FALSE)
head(tr2g_fa)
toy_gtf <- system.file("testdata/gtf_test.gtf", package = "BUSpaRse")
tr2g_tg <- tr2g_gtf(toy_gtf, Genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
                    gene_biotype_use = "cellranger",
                    out_path = "gtf")
head(tr2g_tg)
list.files("gtf")
tr2g_hs <- tr2g_TxDb(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene, get_transcriptome = FALSE,
                     write_tr2g = FALSE)
head(tr2g_hs)
tr2g_hs86 <- tr2g_EnsDb(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86, get_transcriptome = FALSE, 
                        write_tr2g = FALSE, gene_biotype_use = "cellranger",
                        use_gene_version = FALSE, use_transcript_version = FALSE)
head(tr2g_hs86)
